description: The former requirement that reconstruction remain outside .intent until a recorded approve review and promotion is retired.
rationale: The project owner clarified that this was not the intended design: reconstructed history should be actual .intent data available to agents automatically, with evidence, uncertainty and pending verification. The direct-import requirement replaces this gate.
requirements: Require a recorded approve review bound to the content hash plus --confirm
Default to historical bindings; active bindings need an applicability rationale
title: Review-gated promotion into canonical intent (retired)
